chunks: "Whoever looks at the Kaaba, a good deed continues to be written for him and a sin is erased from him until he turns his gaze away from it."

key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Kaaba, the sacred sanctuary in Mecca
key_terms.حَسَنَةٌ: a good deed recorded as reward

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for looking at the Kaaba?
ai.summary: This hadith states the merit of looking at the Kaaba, describing it as an act through which rewards are continuously recorded and sins are erased. It highlights the spiritual sanctity of the Kaaba and the devotional value attached to directing one's gaze toward it.
